exposure: induction of labor (IOL) with Foley catheter (FC)
cohort: 1559 women with a history of previous CS in Helsinki University Hospital, Finland between 2013 and 2014
finding: FC appears safe and effective method for IOL in women with a history of previous CS.
mod_finding: The cesarean section rate was higher in women who underwent labor induction with a Foley catheter compared to those with spontaneous onset of labor.
